environment.description: Celery worker deployed in ECS Fargate task within private subnet (10.0.64.0/19). Redis (ElastiCache) accessible only from the private subnet via security group sg-0a3f7c. Task enqueueing occurs through an internal ALB (arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:us-east-1:XXXX:loadbalancer/app/internal-task-alb/abc123) which has a listener on port 443 configured with mutual TLS authentication. The ALB's trust store (arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:us-east-1:XXXX:truststore/corp-ca-bundle/def456) contains only the corporate intermediate CA. Client certificate validation mode is set to 'verify' (not 'passthrough'). The ALB listener rule forwards to the task-enqueue target group ONLY after successful mTLS handshake. The corporate CA issues client certificates exclusively to internal services registered in the service mesh catalog with a 4-hour TTL. External callers cannot obtain a valid client certificate as the CA's ACME endpoint requires a SPIFFE identity document from the workload attestation agent.

network.nat_gateway: outbound only, no inbound from internet

config.redis_access: ElastiCache in same private subnet, no public endpoint
config.service_mesh: client certs issued only to registered SPIFFE identities
